probe_execution.source:
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--source', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--observed-at', required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
source = args.source.resolve(strict=True)
commands = ('vivado', 'v++', 'vitis', 'xbutil', 'xbmgmt', 'emconfigutil', 'platforminfo')
variables = ('XILINX_XRT', 'XILINX_VITIS', 'XILINX_VIVADO', 'PLATFORM', 'FPGA_BIN_DIR', 'XCLBIN_PATH', 'EMCONFIG_PATH')
roots = ('/opt/Xilinx', '/opt/xilinx', '/tools/Xilinx', '/opt/amd', '/opt/xilinx/xrt', '/usr/local/xilinx/xrt', '/opt/xilinx/platforms')
source_revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=source, text=True).strip()
source_clean = not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all'], cwd=source, text=True)
scan_argv = ['rg', '--files', '--hidden', '--no-ignore', '-g', '!.git/**', '-g', '*.xpfm', '-g', '*.xclbin', '-g', 'emconfig.json', '.']
scan = subprocess.run(scan_argv, cwd=source, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
if scan.returncode not in (0, 1):
    raise RuntimeError('source artifact scan failed')
matches = sorted(line.removeprefix('./') for line in scan.stdout.splitlines())
inputs = ('hw/syn/xilinx/xrt/Makefile', 'tests/regression/common.mk', 'sw/runtime/xrt/Makefile')
report = {
    'schema_version': 1,
    'observed_at_utc': args.observed_at,
    'scope': 'Read-only prerequisite observations in the current execution environment. No vendor tool or emulation workload was launched.',
    'gpu_source_revision': source_revision,
    'gpu_source_clean': source_clean,
    'command_presence_on_inherited_path': {name: shutil.which(name) is not None for name in commands},
    'environment_presence': {name: {'present': name in os.environ, 'nonempty': bool(os.environ.get(name))} for name in variables},
    'standard_install_root_presence': {name: {'exists': Path(name).exists(), 'is_directory': Path(name).is_dir()} for name in roots},
    'source_and_generated_build_artifact_scan': {
        'working_directory': '$SOURCE', 'argv': scan_argv, 'exit_code': scan.returncode,
        'matching_relative_paths': matches,
        'scope': 'The clean source worktree and its generated build directories, including ignored files; no scan of unrelated user directories or external storage.'
    },
    'source_requirement_files': [{'path': name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256((source/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for name in inputs],
    'vendor_release_identified': False,
    'supported_platform_identified': False,
    'matching_hw_emu_artifacts_identified': False,
    'license_readiness': 'unverified; no license server or entitlement probe was performed',
    'outcome': 'blocked',
    'limitations': [
        'Absence on the observed PATH and standard roots does not prove a vendor installation cannot exist elsewhere.',
        'Environment variable values and full PATH are intentionally not retained.',
        'The file scan covers only the source worktree and its generated builds; external artifact stores were not queried.',
        'No vendor hw_emu build, DMA, launch, completion or CPU-reference execution was performed.',
        'Processor rtlsim and vendor-free full-AFU xrtsim cannot substitute for the required vendor hw_emu gate.',
        'This prerequisite screen does not establish a license entitlement, physical FPGA operation or silicon result.'
    ]
}
if any(report['command_presence_on_inherited_path'].values()) or any(x['exists'] for x in report['standard_install_root_presence'].values()) or any(x['nonempty'] for x in report['environment_presence'].values()) or matches:
    report['requires_follow_up'] = 'Some candidate prerequisite was observed; inspect it before claiming vendor availability.'
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

scope: Read-only prerequisite observations in the current execution environment. No vendor tool or emulation workload was launched.

source_and_generated_build_artifact_scan.scope: The clean source worktree and its generated build directories, including ignored files; no scan of unrelated user directories or external storage.

source_requirements: hw/syn/xilinx/xrt/Makefile requires PLATFORM and XILINX_VITIS, invokes platforminfo, the vendor v++ linker and Vivado, and creates matching vortex_afu.xclbin and emconfig.json artifacts.
tests/regression/common.mk explicitly selects XCL_EMULATION_MODE=hw_emu and matching XCLBIN_PATH/EMCONFIG_PATH for the hw_emu target.
sw/runtime/xrt/Makefile selects the local XRTSIM shim only for TARGET=xrtsim; that vendor-free path does not qualify vendor hw_emu.
